incident-bot: ALERT: Inference path p99 spike detected for hosted-api us-west-2 — control-plane auth DB showing high latency (>500ms) for 5m :pager:
incident-bot: Metrics: p95=180ms p99=1.2s error-rate=0.6% streaming-stalls=3/min
maria: looking at dashboards now, joining
maria: auth-db connection queue depth +15, many retries 503s in proxy logs
sam: @maria can you share slow query or stacktrace? I see increased `auth-cache miss` rates

eli: customer impact: some streaming requests see stalls >5s, frontend retries visible. Churn on Dedicated customers in us-west-2 reported via support channel :frowning:
jordan: oncall here, paging now. I’ll take lead for mitigation.
oncall: acknowledged — I’m scaling auth-proxy pool + adding a short TTL bypass on feature flag fetch to reduce DB pressure
sam: thinking: root cause looks like a hot key on feature-flag configfetch causing DB reads. Can we flip a cache-only fallback?
maria: we have a cache-only fallback behind a feature flag `ff/config-cache-fallback` — currently off for some customers. flipping for us-west-2 only should help.
jordan: do it. Runbook step 3: `curl -X POST https://controlplane:8443/flags/ff/config-cache-fallback -d '{"state":"on","scope":"us-west-2"}'`
eli: please also enable short-term rate-limit bump for streaming ingress to avoid backpressure loop on the gateway
sam: rolling command (doing a canary):
```
# bump pool and restart auth-proxy canary
kubectl -n controlplane scale deployment/auth-proxy --replicas=6
kubectl -n controlplane rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy -l region=us-west-2
```
maria: flipping flag now (scoped) — response OK 200
maria: flag change: `ff/config-cache-fallback`=on (region=us-west-2) :white_check_mark:
ops-lead: observed immediate drop in auth DB QPS from 420 -> 160, good sign :eyes:
sre-bot: metric update: p95 reduced to 130ms p99 reduced to 480ms within 60s of flag flip. streaming-stalls down from 3/min to 0.6/min

eli: follow-up: we should keep the flag on for 2 hours, monitor error budget, then plan a proper fix (cache warming + shard hotkey mitigation)
maria: logging indicates a set of feature keys with extremely high read amplification: `org:acme-io:feature_flags` — engineering to investigate later
